reasoning: This is a Phase I dose-escalation trial with a primary endpoint of establishing the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) and dose-limiting toxicity (DLT). The trial successfully met its primary endpoint by establishing the MTD at 50 mg LY3022855 in combination with vemurafenib and cobimetinib. While there were serious adverse events (maculopapular rash, cholecystitis, gallbladder infection) at 20% incidence, these did not prevent dose escalation to the MTD. The trial also showed preliminary efficacy signals with ORR of 20% and PFS of 3.7 months in dose level 1, which are reasonable for a Phase I trial in melanoma. Since the primary safety/tolerability endpoint was met and the combination was deemed tolerable at the established MTD, this represents a successful Phase I trial that achieved its stated objectives.
